verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure platform that holds customer, account and transaction data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion APIs or data-purge controls. SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS compliance and API access to customer data are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
